description:
*GUIDE PRICE £240,000-£220,000*
Don't miss this fantastic opportunity to acquire a beautifully presented two-bedroom terraced bungalow, perfectly suited to those looking to downsize without compromising on comfort, convenience, or security.

Accessed via a secure double-gated entrance with keypad and fob entry system, this attractive home offers peace of mind and exclusivity. The property benefits from its own allocated parking space and is ideally positioned within the sought-after IP1 postcode, with regular bus links, local shops, supermarkets, and everyday amenities all close at hand.

Inside, you'll find two generous double bedrooms, a spacious shower room, and a modern, well-presented kitchen designed for practical living. The bright and welcoming living area provides the perfect space to relax and entertain, with patio doors opening directly onto the rear garden. Outside, the enclosed garden offers a wonderful private retreat, featuring a decking area and secure fencing, making it ideal for enjoying the warmer months or spending time with family and friends.

Properties of this style and location are always in demand, particularly for buyers seeking an easy-to-maintain home with excellent amenities nearby. Contact haart Estate Agents today to arrange your viewing and discover everything this delightful bungalow has to offer.
